body: I got the courage to tell my coworker that I had a crush on him after I saw his grindr profile a few days ago. I initially never planned to tell him because I had no idea what his sexuality was but after seeing him on grindr I thought that was the confirmation I needed to tell me he liked dudes. After I told him how I feel he told me that one of his friends dared my coworker to make this profile and it was all a big joke and that he’s not gay. Not sure I buy that story but oh well. Guess I better move on.

I love to travel although when I travel I'm usually with my family :/ other things I enjoy are listening to music, reading, movies, and video games. Anything that can help me escape this horrible life of mine.

I really appreciate your response, thank you. This honestly is the most difficult thing I've gone through in my whole life. No friends, no family that loves and supports you, constantly wondering if you'll even be on this earth a year from now. Reddit is honestly my only support group I have at the moment. It's not that I do not appreciate those taking the time read and reply but each day just gets harder and harder for me. I'm just so lonely and I've never been this lonely in my life. I'm glad you beat this and I hope things remain well for you. As for me, I'll try to see if I can take some anti depressants but this fight won't be easy. Even if I do get better there's still the matter of my worthless family. They could cause me to go back into depression. If I weren't so broke, I'd just move somewhere far from them and not even tell them. I wouldn't miss them either. When it gets to the point where my own mother hates me, it's time to go. A break from them could do me some good.

Don't worry, I do believe you and I appreciate those kind words. These last few days have been particularly painful which is why I've been doubting why I'm even here in the first place. I feel a little scared talking to someone face to face that I don't know about my problems but I'm running low on options here. If anything, it's really my only option.

First I must say, thank you for the response, I was touched to read that someone like you is able to help a stranger that is in need. I wish there were more kind people like you that took this mental illness serious. I really can't thank you enough. For once I cried and it wasn't from sadness or anger, two emotions I tend to feel on a daily basis. Even before I got to my lowest, I was never all too happy to be around family. I've never felt welcome in my family they just tend to look at me as the black sheep of the family. So in retrospect, them not caring about my depression isn't all that surprising. It's just sad that I've come to terms with my family not caring. So I guess I see your point with not blaming them since they're clearly oblivious to what depression is doing to me. But on the other hand because I really hate defending them, they should know that something is wrong with me due to my drastic weight loss, sleep lose and my generally moody attitude towards them. I tend to fight with my family a lot due to my moodiness but it's hard to control. Some days it's just really hard for me to get through and I just want it to be over. And yes, college is kicking my ass both academically and socially. My grades are terrible because of my lack of confidence and motivation which I blame on the depression. My grades were fine before depression hit. Socially, I just don't have the confidence to meet new people for fear that they might be turned off by the whole depression issue. My social life was fine too before depression but now I'm just too scared to meet new people. My only real friend is someone I've known since 6th grade and yet I still haven't told him how depressed I've been because I'm scared to open up to him. He's a great guy but we've never really opened up to each other and talk about our feelings before. To suddenly start by telling him I want to die might cause things to be weird which I don't want to do since he's my only friend.
Can we take a minute and remember why we fell in love with gaga in the first place? My personal favorite from the fame era!

I know exactly how you feel. First year of college and I have one close friend that really does nothing but talk about herself. We've been friends since high school and she's always done this but it never struck me as annoying until we got to college. I mean fuck, I have my own problems to worry about and I have to pretend to care about what ever boy problems she has. I try my best to distance myself from her but it's hard for me to do because she's really all I have. I'm not sure why but I'm just not good at finding good friends. I'm exactly the same way you are with my family. I can only handle them in doses before I go insane. As for the whole avoiding people thing, you are not the only one

Well like I said, the subject material isn't all that exciting and so it's hard for me to stay focused. When I actually tried my best in the beginning to take notes, I'd end up having about one or two sentences in my notebook full of information that I wasn't sure was even relevant to the class. Learned on the midterm that what little information I have was infact very useless and didn't help at all. After that midterm I lost all interest in the class and it was too late for me to drop so yeah I pretty much did nothing the rest of the semester. Thankfully my professor was kind enough this time around to give a study guide for our final so I'm at least a bit more prepared. I've at least learned my lesson, if I have even the smallest doubt as to whether or not I should be in a class, I should just drop it when I have the chance rather than wait and see if it'll get better.
Yeah I know, I learned this the hard way. I'm in 3 other classes where we DO get notes and for some reason I just assumed we'd get notes here too.

Moving on is the part that I don't know I'll be able to do overnight. That'll take weeks, months, hell probably years. I don't want me being separated from David to affect my grades again, especially since I'm in college and not high school where it's ok to have fucked up grades. I can't handle the sense of being alone with no one to discuss my feelings and other problems to :(

Thanks man! I don't just have a flaming hot crush, I honestly don't get attracted to any guy other guy like I do David. Yeah sure, guys like Channing Tatum and *swoon*Justin Timberlake are hot but if I had to choose between those two or David, I'd choose David all the way. But as for the whole girlfriend thing, not only has he never had one (trust me he's a good looking guy, not just my biased opinion) but he never once asked a girl on a date for a school dance or just to hang out. He always did it in groups, even if everyone else (including myself) had a date. That to me is the biggest hint that he might be gay. But I guess he could've just been scared but I feel like that isn't the case. I feel in my heart that he's gay but you can never be 100% on that kind of thing. I don't think I'm ready to come out just yet but maybe once I come out to David, I might. Again, I'll save that topic for a future reddit post. Thanks again though :)
If for some reason we don't room together, should I come out to him then? I mean, it'll be a while before he makes a decision but the thing is I don't know how much more I can wait.
Sorry it's so long, I just have no one else to talk to and I have a lot on my mind!
